Featuring a relatively low price and an accessible, wireless design the Meta Quest is the best selling headset ever and remains by far the front runner. So having had two years to catch up has anyone else managed to create a VR headset that can matchup to the Quest 2, or even supplant it as the best option? The Quest 1 changed everything by being the first wireless VR headset that was relatively cheap, and it only look just over a year for the Quest 2 to be released. Meta invested and continues to invest massively in content for the Quest 2 and the headset features the largest app store for VR games and experiences. The Quest 2 isn’t the most advanced VR headset; it features a mobile processor and a single LCD screen. The most popular VR headset ever with a huge library of games and experiences. So if you go for the Pico 4 instead of the Quest 2 you’ll likely have a better VR experience, but there will be less choice. ## Meta Quest Pro. The power of the PlayStation 5 will allow you to play much more complicated and better looking VR games than will ever be possible using the Quest 2.
